text: じてんしゃに　のって　きてね

structure.jp: じてんしゃに　のって

patterns.name: 〜て (how)
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb in front of another verb can tell you the way the second thing is done. のって　きて = 'come riding'.

patterns.name: 〜てください
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb left on its own is a casual request, a short form of てください; ね softens it. きてね = 'come, okay?'.
